Activity: Equip 3 Pieces of Gear from an Item Set
Description: More items means more power! And set items are pure power for the budding adventurer. By equipping multiple items from a single set you gain powerful additive bonuses that can completely change how you play your character.

You can earn your crafting writ certification to qualify and then get to fulfilling writs today! Open the map, and look for the marketplace in most major cities across Tamriel. You'll find the crafting job boards nearby!

Description: Harvest crafting resources from plants, ore veins, or any other natural deposit.

Description: Pick a piece of gear and bring it to one of the appropriate crafting stations, found in most major cities. There, you can improve the quality of your equipment by using some specialized crafting materials like tempers or tannins!
Activity Reward: File:ON-icon-temper-Dwarven Oil.png 10 Dwarven Oil 10 Turpen 10 Embroidery

Activity: Deconstruct or Research 3 Pieces of Equipment
Description: You can do all kinds of things with old or unwanted gear. Head to a crafting station to deconstructed unwanted items for their resources. Or use the research window to learn how to craft future pieces using the attributes of the gear you already have.
Activity Reward: File:ON-icon-misc-Instant All Research.png 3 Instant All Research

Description: After combat your equipment may damage, but this can be easily restored by repairing it at a merchant or banging out those dents with a repair kit.
Summon your inner mage! Use an enchanting rune from your inventory and apply that enchantment to any piece of gear you like.
Potions provide a quick boost in combat effectiveness. Buy or craft up a potion with a combat buff and drink it on down!

Description: Rededication Shrines allow you to redistribute spent skill or attribute points after you've made a donation of gold to their Aedric patron.
